guide.line: James Naismith was born in Canada in 1861 and invented basketball in Massachusetts in 1891, as an immigrant physical-education instructor asked to tame a roomful of bored young men through a long New England winter.
guide.copy_md_sentence: James Naismith was born in Canada in 1861 and invented basketball in Massachusetts in 1891, as an immigrant physical-education instructor asked to tame a roomful of bored young men through a long New England winter.

guide.line: He trained in Canada before crossing into the United States, and by the early 1890s he was a physical instructor at the International YMCA Training School in Springfield, Massachusetts.
guide.copy_md_sentence: He trained in Canada before crossing into the United States, and by the early 1890s he was a physical instructor at the International YMCA Training School in Springfield, Massachusetts.

guide.line: In the autumn of 1891 the head of the department, Luther Halsey Gulick, set his instructors a problem: invent an indoor game that could keep a class of young men fit and interested through the winter, when it was too cold and dark to play outside.
guide.copy_md_sentence: In the autumn of 1891 the head of the department, Luther Halsey Gulick, set his instructors a problem: invent an indoor game that could keep a class of young men fit and interested through the winter, when it was too cold and dark to play outside.

guide.line: Naismith was given two weeks to solve it.
guide.copy_md_sentence: Naismith was given two weeks to solve it.

guide.line: Naismith wanted a game of skill rather than brute force — one where you could not run with the ball or tackle the man who had it.
guide.copy_md_sentence: Naismith wanted a game of skill rather than brute force — one where you could not run with the ball or tackle the man who had it.

guide.line: He wrote out thirteen rules, asked a janitor for two boxes, and was handed two peach baskets instead.
guide.copy_md_sentence: He wrote out thirteen rules, asked a janitor for two boxes, and was handed two peach baskets instead.

guide.line: He fixed them to the balcony railings at either end of the gym, about ten feet up, and posted the rules on the wall so the students could read them.
guide.copy_md_sentence: He fixed them to the balcony railings at either end of the gym, about ten feet up, and posted the rules on the wall so the students could read them.

guide.line: The first game, in December 1891, was played with a soccer ball and the baskets, nine players a side.
guide.copy_md_sentence: The first game, in December 1891, was played with a soccer ball and the baskets, nine players a side.

guide.line: But the game spread with astonishing speed through the YMCA network, and the rules were published in 1892.

guide.line: In 1898 Naismith earned a medical degree in Denver and then moved to Lawrence, Kansas, where he would spend the rest of his career.
guide.copy_md_sentence: In 1898 Naismith earned a medical degree in Denver and then moved to Lawrence, Kansas, where he would spend the rest of his career.

guide.line: He died in Lawrence, Kansas, on 28 November 1939, a few weeks after a stroke.
guide.copy_md_sentence: He died in Lawrence, Kansas, on 28 November 1939, a few weeks after a stroke.
